items.title: Tim Cook built Apple’s $32M-an-hour growth machine: Can John Ternus keep it going?
items.summary: Yahoo Finance Executive Editor Brian Sozzi and Tech Editor Dan Howley look back at Tim Cook’s tenure as Apple (AAPL) CEO, a period that saw the company generate roughly $32 million in growth per hour. They also look ahead to incoming CEO John Ternus and what it will take to keep Apple’s growth engine firing.
